messages:
incident-bot: Pager — GPU capacity exhausted in aws-eu-west5. Autoscaler failed to provision new instances due to quota errors. Active queue length: 9.8k. Customer-facing error spike. Paging anna (oncall).

anna (oncall): On it. seeing 5xx from inference-prod, p95 latency up 2x. Link: https://redwood.metrics/prod/queue/aws-eu-west5

mike (eng-runtime): Autoscaler logs show repeated API 403/ServiceQuotaExceeded from AWS EC2: "Requested limit 0 for resource-type GPU in region eu-west-5". Copying logs:
```
2026-02-18T19:02:15Z autoscaler: scaleUp -> request: 12 x p4d denied: ClientError: You've reached your GPU quota for eu-west-5
```

raj (cloud-infra): Confirmed. AWS quota for the GPU instance family is 0 by default in that region — we never provisioned there before. I'm requesting emergency increase but that takes time.

sophie (support-lead): Customers experiencing timeouts on /v1/generate. Support queue has 43 escalations in last 10m. Prioritize paid-tier customers. Drafting status update.

anna (oncall): Mitigations: 1) Reroute traffic away from eu-west5 -> eu-west-1/2 using smart-routing 2) Drop down model size on eu-west5 nodes (if any) 3) Evict non-critical background batch jobs. Which is fastest?

mike (eng-runtime): Fastest: reroute. I'll flip routing policy to prefer eu-west-1/2 and add fallback to dedicated pools. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --region-priority eu-west-1,eu-west-2,eu-west-5 --failover true
```

anna (oncall): Doing that now — switching weight away from eu-west5 to 0. :rotating_light:

mike (eng-runtime): Routing change applied, traffic to eu-west5 down ~85%. Queue length in eu-west5 dropping slowly but overall global queue still high (7.2k) due to capacity saturation in other regions.

tariq (infra-dev): I can evict warmpool/spot-warm nodes allocated to lower-priority work. Will cancel warm-start batches and free up 8 GPUs in eu-west-1 within 3m.

raj (cloud-infra): Status on AWS request: submitted SEV increase via support case #INC-4521, but quoted ETA 4-6 hours for provisioning. Browser shows limit 0 -> requested 50.

sophie (support-lead): Sent customer note: "We're aware of intermittent timeouts in EU regions affecting inference. We're rerouting traffic and prioritizing paid customers. ETA updates in 30m." Posting now.

mike (eng-runtime): Another mitigation: enable model-level token cap and reduce batch sizes to drop throughput demand. Pushing config change:
```
redwoodctl config set serving.batch_target_tokens 512 --scope region:eu
```

anna (oncall): Applying token cap across EU now.

incident-bot: Alert — high queue backlog persists in non-routed regions. p99 latency 22s. Error rate 5.6%.

raj (cloud-infra): If quota increase delayed, alternate path: create temporary Dedicated pool in eu-west-2 and failover tenant routing for top customers. That will need finance/ops approval? but emergency overprovision might be possible via existing reserved pools.

tariq (infra-dev): I'm provisioning dedicated fallback with available reserved GPUs in eu-west-2, will take ~7m. Kicking off:
```
rwinfctl pool create --type dedicated --region eu-west-2 --gpus 24 --name emergency-fallback
```

mike (eng-runtime): Good. Once pool is up we'll map critical tenants. Also enabling aggressive caching of prefix KV for long-running sessions.

sophie (support-lead): Noted. I've prioritized mapping for 3 largest impacted customers: AcmeCorp, Lensly, NotableAI.

anna (oncall): Quick customer impact: approx 12% of live requests in EU saw >5s latency, 2% failed. Potential session loss for long chats. No data leak risk. Support triage continues.

raj (cloud-infra): AWS replied: case updated, if we provide business justification and escalation we can get a temporary allocation in ~1-2h. I've escalated via partner rep. Keeping support ticket pinned.

mike (eng-runtime): Post-mitigation plan: 1) add region quota check to deployment hook 2) autoscaler should fall back to warm pools before requesting new webscale instances 3) add synthetic traffic to detect dead regions earlier.

tariq (infra-dev): Emergency pool available in eu-west-2 ready to accept traffic. I'll start remapping critical tenants now.

anna (oncall): Remapping started. Reducing sampling on eval jobs to prevent noise.

incident-bot: Incident update — traffic reroute and emergency pool reduced customer 5xx rate to 0.8% in the last 5m. Queue backlog decreasing.

sophie (support-lead): Posting update to status page and Zendesk. Template used:
"We're mitigating a GPU provisioning issue in the EU region causing timeouts. We've rerouted traffic and activated fallback capacity; service is recovering."

mike (eng-runtime): Next actions: follow up on quota approval, implement preflight quota checks, add autoscaler retry/backoff patch. I'll open PR and schedule postmortem.

anna (oncall): If anyone wants to join warroom for postmortem, ping me. Closing pager for now — will keep thread open for escalation. :thumbsup:

sophie (support-lead): Thanks team. Logging RCA notes and customer emails. closing loop with customers in 60m unless regression.
